findings.text: current_normalisation_amplitude now returns jnp.zeros_like(target) where the admissibility flag is false, and current_normalisation_admissible has no production consumer (only the test file calls it), so on the traced production route (gs.py:34 -> _internal_on_partition -> scaled_current_moments at 3525) a non-finite total current now scales every cell to zero and the solve proceeds on a zero plasma source with no refusal, where the base returned jnp.nan and the solver refused the step as nonfinite_linear_action.

the mask returned by refuse_non_finite_cell_moments is discarded at all three solve paths (3523, 3710, 3732) and no solve receipt carries an offending index, so done_when clause (2)'s report-by-index is unmet on the only route that runs in a solve; on a traced state indices is () by construction and the mask itself goes nowhere.

the repaired arc root sits in a file outside the node's declared write grant; it is disclosed in the manifest scope_note under a lead ruling of 2026-10-24 that this review cannot verify from the shas.

the fragment states that the mask reaches the host through the three solve paths, but each of those paths drops the return value and none of them is a host boundary, so the sentence describes an effect the code does not have.

np.testing.assert_array_equal compares np.asarray(moments.radial_moment) against original, which is that same array, so the assertion cannot fail whatever the code does and does not show that no value is altered.

the assertion compares refuse_non_finite_cell_moments(moments) against the mask cell_moment_nonfinite(moments) computed immediately before; both sides derive from the same call chain, so a regression that emptied the mask would leave the assertion true.

test_the_traced_amplitude_never_scales_a_cell_by_nan asserts only that the amplitude is finite, so it passes on the silent zero at forward_operator.py:3691 and on any constant the branch might return; no test asserts that an inadmissible traced amplitude is refused or flagged anywhere a caller reads.

the header records revision=c4bd203138321627a145d7850961cbe7e914aa60, three commits before the reviewed head, and row-mask.log ran with PYTHONPATH on the live worktree rather than from a git archive of a committed tip as the brief requires, so neither log quantifies the reviewed revision.

done_when clause (3) is unmet: the direct importer sweep ran 37 files in both arms and 4 tip-only of 79 listed, with both arms ending TIMEOUT at EXIT=124, so 38 files that import forward_operator or source were never measured against the base.
